FN-D9YITN-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 260
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Chris Sells
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/12/2023
House Bill 260 as reported by the Committee on Boards, Agencies and Commissions: (1)
codifies the current practice of the Alabama Electronic Security Board of Licensure to provide
for the requirements of a Qualifying Agent licensee and the process for disciplinary actions; (2)
require a licensee to advertise under the name in which licensed; (3) allow the Board to
immediately impose a penalty on an individual or business that has not renewed their license;
(4) increase the penalty to an injunction action from up to $1,000 to up to $5,000; (5) allow the
Board to file a civil action to collect an awarded judgment; and (6) formalize the collection of
administrative fines and of the handling of complaints made to the Board. This could increase
receipts to the Board's fund by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of imposed
fines and court judgments collected.
